recreation_brief:
1. Set up a 16:9 slide with a solid light gray background (#D9D9D9).
2. Draw a thick black (#000000) rectangle spanning the full slide width along the bottom edge as a footer bar (approximately 5% of slide height).
3. Add the title as two centered lines near the top: line 1 'Check class of each background point', line 2 'in the following datasets'; bold sans-serif, red (#C00000).
4. At the top-right corner, place a yellow (#FFC000) circle with a black outline containing the black text '40' (slide number badge).
5. Build a 3x2 grid of six panels in the center of the slide below the title: three panels in the top row, three in the bottom row, evenly spaced.
6. For each panel, first place a label box: a rounded rectangle with light blue fill, blue border, and dark blue (#000080) sans-serif text. Top row labels left-to-right: 'Aggregation.txt', 'Compound.txt', 'Spiral.txt'. Bottom row labels left-to-right: 'Pathbased.txt', 'Flame.txt', 'Jain.txt'.
7. Directly below each label box, draw a white (#FFFFFF) square with a red (#FF0000) border as the scatter plot area.
8. In the top-left panel ('Aggregation.txt'), plot: blue (#0000FF) clusters in the upper-left; a cyan (#00FFFF) cluster in the upper-right; a small red (#FF0000) cluster; a small yellow (#FFFF00) cluster; a large magenta (#FF00FF) cluster in the lower-middle; a black (#000000) cluster in the lower-right; and a tiny green (#00FF00) cluster in the lower-left.
9. In the top-center panel ('Compound.txt'), plot: scattered black (#000000) clusters on the left; a magenta (#FF00FF) cluster at center-left; a green (#00FF00) filled ring-shaped cluster at lower-left; a blue (#0000FF) blob in the upper-right of the right half; and a red (#FF0000) dotted cluster on the right side.
10. In the top-right panel ('Spiral.txt'), plot interleaved spirals of blue (#0000FF), red (#FF0000), and black (#000000) points forming concentric spiral arms.
11. In the bottom-left panel ('Pathbased.txt'), plot: red (#FF0000) points forming an outer spiral/ring; a blue (#0000FF) cluster at center-left; a black (#000000) cluster at center-right; and red dotted points trailing.
12. In the bottom-center panel ('Flame.txt'), plot: blue (#0000FF) points forming a downward curve (flame base) on the left and right; and a red (#FF0000) cluster at top-center.
13. In the bottom-right panel ('Jain.txt'), plot: a blue (#0000FF) cluster in the upper-left; and red (#FF0000) points forming a C-shaped curve on the right.
14. Do not add any other text, bullets, or elements; leave the slide static with no animations.
